description: This source file defines a service for aggregating Large Language Model (LLM) cost data by agent. It includes functions to resolve collection candidates based on environment variables, build MongoDB aggregation pipelines for different schemas, and perform in-process fallback aggregation if database aggregation fails. The main exported function, getLlmCostByAgent, attempts to fetch and aggregate cost data from MongoDB collections, supporting multiple schema formats and providing fallbacks.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates()
methods.description: Determines collection names to query based on environment variable LLM_EVENTS_COLLECTION and default fallback list, eliminating duplicates and preserving order.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process documents in a flat schema format, extracting agent names and costs, normalizing agent casing, and summing costs by agent.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process documents with an Agents array, extracting agent names and costs from array elements, normalizing casing, and summing costs by agent.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Performs in-process aggregation over a provided array of documents with Agents field, summing costs case-insensitively and preserving display casing.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main exported async function; attempts to retrieve and aggregate LLM cost data from MongoDB collections using aggregation pipelines. Falls back to in-process aggregation if database-side aggregation errors or yields no results. Returns an array of agents with total costs.
